SELECT p.id, v.id AS vehicle_id, v.vin, v.lifecycle_stage, p.stage_status, p.payment_date, p.credit_full_payment_date, p.payment_status, p.remark5, CASE WHEN latest.invoice_type = 'INVOICED' AND latest.stage_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_formal_invoice, p.confirmed_by, p.confirmed_at FROM t_vehicle v LEFT JOIN t_veh_payment p ON p.vehicle_id = v.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.* FROM t_veh_invoice i INNER JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, MAX(invoice_seq) AS max_seq FROM t_veh_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY vehicle_id ) x ON x.vehicle_id = i.vehicle_id AND x.max_seq = i.invoice_seq WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) latest ON latest.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND v.lifecycle_stage = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
AND v.vin LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.vin}, '%')
AND p.payment_status = #{query.paymentStatus}
AND p.stage_status = #{query.stageStatus}
AND 1 = 0
AND latest.invoice_type = 'INVOICED' AND latest.stage_status = 'CONFIRMED'
AND (latest.invoice_type IS NULL OR latest.invoice_type != 'INVOICED' OR latest.stage_status != 'CONFIRMED')
ORDER BY v.id DESC
